title: Social surface identity
summary: A platform has many account-bound surfaces: Steam reviews, Discord channels, YouTube replies/creator features, marketplace seller communications, local business reviews, email and private messaging.
invariants: Surface = provider+family+resource+visibility, item references are nested below surfaces.
Semantically supported surface families are not a claim of a permitted live vendor API.
